Lessons.Title: Meters and Kilometers
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will describe the multiplicative relationship between kilometers and meters and express the former in terms of the latter.
Previously, you learned that 1 meter is 100 times as long as 1 centimeter. You converted measurements in meters to centimeters. In this lesson, you extend your understanding of metric units of length to include kilometers.
Core relationship: Meters and kilometers. Use 1 kilometer = 1,000 meters and convert before comparing distances.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Number Talk: Times Hundreds and Thousands	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  How Long is One Kilometer?	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Meters and Kilometers	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  How Far Away from School?	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: How many meters are in 3 kilometers?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Convert 2 km 450 m to meters.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
